levels.name: low
levels.description: Easy to undo, local to this task, and no effect on other people or on public interfaces. Examples: a name inside one module, the order of steps, a test detail.

levels.name: medium
levels.description: Changes a design, a public API, a file layout or a convention, but a review can still undo it.

levels.name: high
levels.description: Hard to undo, or with an effect outside the repository: deletes data, publishes, sends, spends money, or changes security. Never applied by default.
